manual.title: Connect a UBox camera
manual.description: Enter the device credentials. Setup validates the entries locally and does not wake the camera. Leave the relay host blank to use automatic relay selection.

account.title: UBox account
account.description: Sign in with your UBox email address and UBox password. Account credentials are used only to discover cameras and are not saved. Direct Sign in with Apple is not supported.

camera.title: Select a camera
camera.description: Choose a camera. Leave the name blank to use its camera name, and the relay host blank for automatic relay selection.

error.invalid_uid: Enter a camera UID containing 1–20 printable ASCII characters.
error.invalid_password: Enter a device password containing 1–20 printable ASCII characters.
error.invalid_relay_host: Enter a hostname or IPv4 address, optionally followed by a port (1–65535).
error.invalid_auth: UBox rejected the login. Check the account credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach UBox. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: UBox did not return usable camera credentials.
error.challenge_required: UBox requires additional verification. Sign in using the UBox app first or use manual setup.
error.invalid_device: Choose a camera from the list.

abort.no_devices: No compatible cameras were found in the UBox account.

init.title: Camera settings
init.description: Leave the password blank to keep the saved password. Clear the relay host to restore automatic relay selection.

error.invalid_password: Enter a device password containing 1–20 printable ASCII characters.
error.invalid_relay_host: Enter a hostname or IPv4 address, optionally followed by a port (1–65535).
